description: This file provides functions to fetch and process attraction data from the OpenTripMap API. It defines helper functions for API key retrieval, JSON fetching with error handling, and a public function to search for attractions within a radius based on geographic coordinates.

methods.name: getApiKey()
methods.description: Retrieves the API key from environment variables or returns an empty string.

methods.name: getJson(url)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to the provided URL, with error handling for network errors and non-OK HTTP responses, and returns the parsed JSON.

methods.name: fetchAttractionsByRadius({ lat, lon, radius = 3000, kinds = 'interesting_places', limit = 30 })
methods.description: Fetches a list of attractions within a specified radius around given latitude and longitude, with optional parameters for kinds, limit, and radius. It processes the results to include IDs, names, coordinates, kinds, and ratings.
